record.context_brief: uniformization for complete Kähler manifolds with positive bisectional curvature
record.original_question: Conjecture: every complete Kähler manifold M^n with positive bisectional curvature is biholomorphic to complex Euclidean space C^n.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 4.7. For a complete Kähler manifold \(M^n\) with positive bisectional curvature, \(k_{bs}>0\), then \(M\) is biholomorphic to \(\mathbb{C}^n\).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M^n$ be a connected complete Kähler manifold of complex dimension $n$, equipped with a Kähler metric whose holomorphic bisectional curvature is everywhere positive. (Recall that the holomorphic bisectional curvature at a point $p \in M$ is the function that assigns to each pair of nonzero vectors $X, Y \in T_p^{1,0}M$ the quantity $R(X,\bar X, Y, \bar Y)/(\|X\|^2\|Y\|^2)$, where $R$ is the curvature tensor of the Kähler metric.)

Prove or disprove: every such manifold $M^n$ is biholomorphic to complex Euclidean space $\mathbb{C}^n$.
artifact.status_search_result: This is Yau's uniformization conjecture, which remains open in full generality. Substantial partial results exist: G. Liu proved the conjecture under the additional assumption of maximal volume growth (and the nonnegative-curvature variant with maximal volume growth), Chau–Tam proved earlier cases under bounded curvature with maximal volume growth, the complex dimension 2 case under positive sectional curvature has recently been established, and progress for non-maximal volume growth has been obtained. The general conjecture without auxiliary assumptions is still unresolved.

status_evidence.title: On Yau's uniformization conjecture (Liu)
status_evidence.snippet: Proves Yau's uniformization conjecture under the assumption of maximal volume growth.
status_evidence.claim: The maximal-volume-growth case of the conjecture is solved.

status_evidence.title: A survey on Yau's uniformization conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Survey describing partial results and open status of Yau's uniformization conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture remains open in general; only partial results are known.

status_evidence.title: Yau's uniformization conjecture for manifolds with non-maximal volume growth
status_evidence.snippet: Treats cases of the conjecture beyond maximal volume growth.
status_evidence.claim: Further partial progress in the non-maximal volume growth setting.

status_evidence.title: Uniformisation of complete Kähler surfaces with positive sectional curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes biholomorphism to C^2 for complete Kähler surfaces with positive sectional curvature.
status_evidence.claim: Two-dimensional case under positive sectional curvature is settled.
